title: lmx read-only terminal catalog
description: A2UI v0.9.1 subset. Closed self-contained JSONL fences; 16 KiB, 32 messages, 4 surfaces, depth 8 and 32 graph visits. No functions, actions, templates or theme overrides. Tables require one cell per header; bar charts require one value per label. Nested Column and Row flow layouts; compact by default. Bounded widths, padding, gaps, alignment and minimum container heights; no absolute positioning. Four diagram leaves maximum; shared 64,000 rendered cells, per variant 200 columns and 100 rows. Mermaid source <=8192 bytes; nodes <=16, edges <=32, participants <=8, events <=48 with depth <=4 and branches <=4, boundaries <=6. Labels <=256 bytes and single-cell characters. Complete geometry or text relationships; theme-controlled colours. State and ER diagrams, nested flowchart groups and multiline labels. At most 6 groups, scope depth 4, 16 attributes per entity and 64 total attributes.
